verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers webhooks that notify external systems in real time when subscription events occur, which can be used to build automation, but there is no native rule-builder or conditional trigger→action engine within RevenueCat itself. A community request for additional automation (e.g., timed hooks before trial expiration) further suggests this capability is limited to raw event notification rather than in-product rule definition. missing for 10: native rules/conditions engine, built-in scheduled/triggered actions beyond webhooks, evidence of user-defined automation workflows.
